text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Friday noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament is expected to consider next week a draft law on imosing a 29 percent profit tax on the income of off-shore companies.

- The chairman of parliament, Vytautas Landsbergis, said on Thursday in Washington that he was worried that after President Boris Yeltsin's era was over, Russia might attempt to expand its influence in the Baltic countries.
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas continues his official two-day visit to Poland.
